slides.texte_overlay:
Small luxuries every man
should learn to enjoy
A proper breakfast on Sunday. Real coffee, eggs cooked slowly, no phone at the table. One unhurried morning a week resets your mind better than any weekend trip.
Fresh sheets on a Friday. Changing your bed before the weekend costs nothing, and sliding into clean sheets after a long week feels like checking into a good hotel.
A long walk with no destination. Pick a neighbourhood you don't know and wander for an hour. You come back calmer, with new ideas and often a new favourite place.
Learning something just for pleasure. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and that little moment of curiosity has become one of the best parts of my day.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. That little moment of curiosity has become one of the best parts of my day.

slides.texte_overlay: A good haircut and a hot towel shave. Once in a while, let a skilled barber take care of you. You walk out looking sharp and feeling like a new man.
A meal cooked for people you love. Spend the afternoon on one great dish, invite three friends, open a bottle. Few luxuries feel as rich as a full table at home.
Going to bed early on purpose. No reason, no excuse, just rest. Waking up fully recharged on a weekday is a luxury most men forget they can give themselves.
